question: Is there an unassessed public yeast endocytosis dataset pairing actin or myosin recruitment with inward motion or an event proxy under a stated perturbation, with an interpretable small processed-data contract?
rationale: Current mammalian empirical branches stopped at explicit measurement gaps. Broad clathrin authorization permits other organisms, but their mechanics must not be silently transferred to mammalian cells. A bounded fresh screen is more informative than extending the completed duration theorem or repeating closed access audits.
required_fields: One selected primary paper and verified identity if found
Joint same-event measurements versus condition summaries
Perturbation, marker identities, event/motion proxy and grouping
Concrete public processed table/archive member named only if verified
Data request-only versus public availability distinct
Selection and uncertainty; species-specific inference limit
One next decision or precise no-candidate/access/contract gap
excluded_reopenings: New force inference without observation/load contract
stop_condition: One screened candidate or exact negative/gap, independent scope review. No iterative searches after query/time limit; no automatic dataset download.
